question: In ΔABC, ∠A = 66° and ∠B = 50°. The bisectors of ∠B and ∠C meet at P. Then, ∠BPC + ∠PCA = ?
solution:
**Given:**

∠A = 66°

∠B = 50°

The bisectors of ∠B and ∠C meet at P

**Concept used:**

Sum of three angles of a triangle is 180 degree

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c492f6b389509863fcf3b8b9029abcfb4de8a558e2262c01520e450040e4d300.png] 

∠A + ∠B + ∠C = 180°

⇒ 66° + 50° + ∠C = 180°

⇒ 116° + ∠C = 180°

⇒ ∠C = (180° – 116°)

⇒ ∠C = 6
